statements.status_notes: Same purl and rationale as CVE-2024-6485: bootstrap 3.4.1 is bundled into nbclassic static assets and only loaded if a user actively chooses the legacy /tree UI. The default JupyterLab 4.x UI does not load it.

bootstrap 3.4.1 is bundled inside nbclassic's static client-side assets. nbclassic is a compatibility shim for the legacy Jupyter Notebook UI; the default UI shipped here is JupyterLab 4.x which uses its own styling and does not load nbclassic's bootstrap bundle. The XSS path runs in the user's browser only if they navigate to the classic UI under /tree, and only with input the user controls (notebook content rendered into their own browser).
